Chand @ Mursaleen vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15
February, 2024

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:25738
Court No. - 65
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 52704 of 2023
Applicant :- Chand @ Mursaleen
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Kumar Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 300 of 2020, under Sections 376, 506, 328, 120B IPC, Section 3/4 POCSO Act and Section 67-A of I.T. Act and Section 3(2)(5) of SC/ST Act, P.S. Phase-II Noida, District Gautam Buddha Nagar, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared on behalf of first informant despite service of notice.

Chand @ Mursaleen vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191844154/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The alleged incident of rape has been shown of one and a half year prior to the incident and this long delay in lodging of the first information report has not been explained.

Learned counsel has referred the statement of victim girl, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C, as well as the statement of other witnesses and submitted that allegations of making the video of victim girl viral have been levelled against co-accused Shan @ Sonu.

It has also been submitted that no video has been found in the mobile phone of the applicant and that the allegations that video of victim was made viral and sent to others, are thoroughly false and improbable.
It has further been submitted that in her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has not made any allegation of rape against the applicant.
Learned counsel has pointed out that as per statement of victim, the alleged intoxicated cold drink was also brought by co-accused Shan @ Sonu.

It is further submitted that the first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 18.11.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 12368 of 2021 and after that the statement of victim has already been recorded before the trial Court.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 12368 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Statement of victim / P. W.
1 recorded before the trial Court was referred and it is submitted that there are contradictions and infirmities in the statement of the victim.

Lastly, it is submitted that applicant is in jail since 27.5.2020 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than three years and eight months and that the statement of the victim has already been recorded but the other witnesses are not turning up.
It was submitted that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in the trial.

4. Learned A. G. A. has opposed the bail application and submitted that the first bail application of the applicant has already been rejected and victim has made allegation of rape against the applicant.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Chand @ Mursaleen involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.2.2024 HR  Chand @ Mursaleen vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191844154/
